name: GLP-1 Buddy
tagline: Weekly injection reminders and a symptom log you can hand to a doctor
description: A tracking companion for people on weekly GLP-1 treatment such as semaglutide or tirzepatide. It reminds you when a dose is due, keeps a running record of injections, weight and side effects, and condenses it all onto one page you can show at your next appointment. It records and reminds; it does not advise medically.
author: TinaMBean
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
